info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Deliverys-v2-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Delivery API provides users with the ability to retrieve a comprehensive list of pharmacy prescriptions scheduled for delivery. This endpoint serves pharmacies and healthcare providers, enabling them to efficiently track and manage deliveries of prescriptions to patients. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can enhance their operational workflows, ensuring timely service and improved communication with patients. Typical use cases include monitoring delivery statuses and making informed decisions regarding medication management.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the delivery details of prescriptions, including status, expected arrival time, and related information about the delivery process.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching delivery details related to prescriptions. This body should adhere to the specified schema and contain the required parameters.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsDeliverysReques.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to prescription delivery. It contains serialized string data that will be processed by the API.
